summary: This is a routine earnings filing on Form 6-K reporting unaudited interim financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is announced. The filing merely contains condensed financial statements, management discussion, and a press release. As a foreign private issuer routine report, it does not constitute a special situation event.
